known.title: Windows blocks the installer on some PCs
known.body: The installer isn't code-signed, so a new version can be refused, sometimes with a message about permissions. Right-click Roamies-Setup.exe, choose Properties, tick Unblock, press OK, then run it. The Microsoft Store's copy is not affected.

known.title: Screens with different scaling side by side
known.body: Monitors set to different scaling next to each other, like 100% beside 150%, are not handled yet.

known.title: The Microsoft Store's copy runs a little behind
known.body: Each version reaches the Store after Microsoft has checked it, which takes from a few hours to a few days.

incidents.title: The friend server stopped answering
incidents.body: A problem at its host took it down, so friends, visits and sign-in were out for about a day. It was moved to a new host that evening, and version 1.5.0 points the app there. Pets, saves and coins were not affected: those live on your computer.
